Sets the topic to query and subscribe to. The topic specified can be the
literal topic name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

A comma-delimited set of options for this command. See the
sow_and_subscribe section for a full description of supported options.
For example, to remove all fields except for id and ticker, and also
request out of focus notifications, you might use an options string of:
oof,select=[-/,+/id,+/ticker].
